scope: Actual fixed-step physical snapshot/input replay, seeded measurements, controller A/B, historical metadata and bounded persistence. No browser GPU/pixel/FPS acceptance.

evidence.name: Presentation captures initial and final weather / camera without changing physical identity or numerical A/B conditions
Complete live snapshot and command journal continue bitwise-identically with actual seeded delayed observation, inherited wind phase, nozzle fault and wing commands
30 / 60 / 120 display-frame grouping yields identical physical responses, exact input journals and raw statistics
Driving record replays at the fixed solver step and captures raw wheel speed, slip and separate applied inputs
Display decimation never changes physical snapshots, command inputs, peaks, integrals or statistic source

sampling.note: 展示曲线已经抽稀；请使用每行 timeS。汇总量保留原始固定步统计，不由此曲线重算。

evidence.name: Historical model/build identities are preserved: exact replay refuses wrong build, explicit same-schema current-build recompute is labelled
Fair controller A/B imports the same full initial conditions and seed, changing only declared gains
A/B rejects undeclared factors and in-run changes that would overwrite the compared constant controller gain
Cancelled numerical execution retains identity, source, actual completed duration and partial measured statistics
Physical solver faults and rejected API interventions remain recorded, not reported as successful completion
Program automation is captured as actual commands / fixed inputs; pilot takeover finishes the auto record with a cancellation outcome
Bounded persistence refuses silent eviction, keeps exact replay conditions after refresh, and protects corrupt old archives
Imported replay validates finite state, command allowlist and exact step totals without executing content
Program compressed CSV and standard historical CSV identify the stored report and truthful sample interval
